'''Intuitive Link''' is a [[Link skill]] that targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, their [[hit]]s can [[trigger]] your supported spells. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

==Skill functions and interactions==
Spells triggered by {{sl|id=SupportIntuitiveLink|name=Intuitive Link Support}} gain a 0.5 second cooldown, count as triggered by the player who cast the link skill, and will spend their [[cost]] when triggered.
